7 Brew Key Lime Pie Lemonade: Price, Calories & Caffeine

A medium Key Lime Pie Lemonade is about $3.50, with 280 calories, 0 mg of caffeine and 66 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Key Lime Pie Lemonade allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists Milk for the Key Lime Pie Lemonade. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Key Lime Pie Lemonade

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Key Lime Pie Lemonade?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Key Lime Pie Lemonade at Home

No top guide gives you a measured version of this one, so here is the build in kitchen terms. The pie effect is lime plus white chocolate. That is the whole trick.

For one large glass

  • 1 1/2 cups lemonade
  • 1 tablespoon lime syrup, or the juice of half a lime plus a teaspoon of sugar
  • 1 tablespoon white chocolate sauce
  • A full cup of ice
  1. Stir the white chocolate sauce into a splash of the lemonade first, until it loosens. Sauce dumped straight onto ice just sits there.
  2. Add the rest of the lemonade and the lime, stir, then ice.
  3. Taste for the pie balance: sharp lime up front, creamy sweet behind it.

The crust move (home only): the stand version has no crust element at all, but at home a rim of crushed graham cracker on the glass gets you the full slice. It is your addition, not theirs, and it works.

7 Brew Key Lime Pie Lemonade FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Key Lime Pie Lemonade?

A medium iced Key Lime Pie Lemonade has 280 calories. A small has 210 and a large 420, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Key Lime Pie Lemonade?

0 mg. Lemonade, lime and white chocolate carry no caffeine at any size.

How much does a 7 Brew Key Lime Pie Lemonade cost?

Roughly $2.75 for a small, $3.50 for a medium and $4.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Key Lime Pie Lemonade?

66 g in a medium.

Is Key Lime Pie Lemonade dairy-free?

No, and this matters, so here it is plainly. The creamy part of this drink is white chocolate sauce, and the allergen chart in 7 Brew's official nutrition guide lists that sauce under Milk. That means the standard build is milk-flagged before you add a single topping, no cream or cold foam needed. One top guide answers this question with possibly, ask if it can be swapped. The guide itself is clearer than that. If dairy is a hard no for you, this is not your lemonade. Our allergen guide maps the safer picks.

Does it actually taste like key lime pie?

Like the filling, yes. Like the whole pie, no, because nothing in the cup plays the crust. The lime lands bright and sharp first, the lemon keeps it tart, and then the white chocolate rounds the edges off, which is exactly what the filling does on a fork. Fans describe it as key lime pie filling over ice, and that is fair. Two ordering notes from people who drink it a lot: half sweet is the consensus, because at full sweet the lime can bulldoze the lemon. And iced tastes crisper, frozen tastes like dessert.

Why do other sites say 230 to 340 calories for a medium?

Because they are publishing ranges instead of reading the guide. One big guide estimates a medium at 230 to 340 and puts its sugar at 42 to 60 g, which is under the real figure. Another puts a small anywhere from 110 to 230, and 110 is less than half the actual drink. The official guide gives one number per size: a medium iced is 280 calories and 66 g of sugar, a small is 210, a large is 420. Those are the numbers in the table above. A range that brackets the truth is not the truth.

Is there a sugar-free Key Lime Pie Lemonade?

No published one. A sugar-free white chocolate sauce does exist as an ingredient, and you will see guides hint at a lighter build because of it. But the guide has no sugar-free Key Lime Pie entry at all, and the lemonade base underneath is sweetened regardless, so there is no official number to quote and no true zero to order. Half sweet or quarter sweet is the honest lever here, and the lime holds up well at half. Every drink that does offer a sugar-free version is compared on our sugar-free page.

Is Key Lime Pie Lemonade still on the menu?

Yes. One of the top guides, written in February 2026, warns that it is no longer on the printed menu. The official 7 Brew page still lists it as a current lemonade, checked again in late October 2026, iced, chiller or lemon freeze. Printed-menu notes age fast with this chain. If a stand has run out of a flavor, that is a stock day, not a discontinuation.
